the_ruling: Every component that can learn is a question nexus. Its fire-path — gates, filters, rulestacks, callbacks — is HARDWARE: deterministic code that changes only by installation (evidence-provenanced, ratified, versioned), never in place. Above hardware, a nexus may grow a GRAPH TREE; only above a tree may it grow an LLM CEILING — the tree is the prerequisite because it is the deposit path that makes inference temporary. A verdict is always hardware.

cc_read.what_replaced_what: The inference-free falsifiers on orient and build_inspector were a blanket ban standing in for a distinction we couldn't enforce pre-Hex: the puppet fear (inference doing the work while the code is theater — unmeasurable, unreproducible). The ban is replaced by measurement: per-field provenance labels who answered; the dial reds a nexus whose floor+tree fraction isn't growing. A puppet stops being forbidden by prose and becomes detectable by instrument (Law 3 doing Law 4's old job, with a better gate).
cc_read.the_ladder: Hardware needs nothing under it. A tree may sit only above hardware. A ceiling may sit only above a tree. No rung skips, because each rung is the EXIT PATH for the one above it: an LLM fallback with no tree has nowhere to deposit, so its inference is permanent — and permanent inference wearing a component's name IS the puppet. 'Graph-tree learning is a prerequisite for LLM fallback' is the anti-puppet law stated positively.
cc_read.hardware_earns_its_name: Build-to-the-tool: hardware in the native domain is the tier that changes only by installation — deliberate, versioned, you flash the firmware and note the revision. Gates/filters/rulestacks/callbacks change the same way: through the admission door (a proposal wearing a dated failure as provenance — orient's tooth 12 generalized — ratified, teeth re-green), never mid-fire. Buys replayability for free: a verdict's provenance names the registry version; same input + same revision = same verdict, which is what lets a verdict be permanent in a record of truth (Law 7). Sharper than CC's first cut (which allowed floor+tree at fire-time): tree state mutates with every deposit, so a live tree-walk verdict isn't replayable — the tree's learnings reach hardware by COMPILING INTO it, not by being consulted at judgment.
cc_read.word_flag_kept: 'Enforcers are always deterministic code' — the word 'enforcer' was ruled out 2026-07-17 (no supervisor role; enforcement IS gated ownership). Same content rendered without the loaded word: A VERDICT IS ALWAYS HARDWARE. Akien's second phrasing subsumes the first anyway (gates are hardware; hardware is deterministic).
cc_read.two_falsifiers_per_nexus: The dial catches both hollow shapes: floor+tree fraction never growing = puppet (ceiling doing the floor's job forever); registry static across corrections = dead learner ('just a linter' — orient's wrong-shape signal generalized). Home-field caution carried: a nexus learning its own gate can manufacture leniency (librarian measured manufactured resolution at 0.8295), so registry admission stays evidence-gated and, for gate filters, Akien-ratified.
cc_read.event_discipline: Ceilings fire at LEARN-TIME events only — a correction, a red, a /moreabout, a floor refusal. Never per-crossing, never on a clock (NO DAEMONS; shrinking footprint: a mature nexus's ceiling almost never wakes).
cc_read.migration: By grafting, not big-bang (Law 8): orient and build_inspector become nexi on their NEXT LEARNING EVENT — the first correction that would grow a scan or filter runs through the nexus loop instead of the bespoke prose path. One child ticket each, cast when the event fires (the standing stone cadence: edges now, tickets when fired), existing teeth kept green throughout. No proven wall moves to satisfy uniformity ahead of need. EVENT REDEFINED AND FIRED 2026-07-28 (fourth verbatim above): building ANYTHING is the learning event — every build orients and every build is gated, so every build teaches both. The chart-tree stone's build fired it; tickets orient-nexus-graft + build-inspector-nexus-graft cast the same day at TICKETME, BUILDME gated on chart-tree proving the shared multi-tenant tree machinery. GRAFTS LANDED, SAME DAY STILL: both tickets rode TICKETME→PROVED on Akien's 'go go go' — orient/nexus.py + build_inspector/nexus.py over chart's owner-generalized nexus verbs (one nexus shape, three tenants: chart, orient, build_inspector — each its own table through db_domain's one gate). Fire-paths untouched and AST-pinned in BOTH directions (the tree physically unreachable at measure/verdict-time — the ruling's sharpest line is now import physics, not prose); admission doors unchanged (tooth 12 / tooth 10 + ratification); the founding scars and candidate questions are the corpora's first residents, including the dial-trend question — this note's own falsifier queued at the gate's admission door. The migration named in this section is COMPLETE: every component it names is a nexus.
cc_read.payoff: Akien's stated payoff lands structurally: 'this would make every unit a learning unit without having to supervise that' — the charter question 'how does this component learn?' collapses to one answer shape (it's a nexus; here's its tree, here's its dial), which is the path to retiring that Rules-awaiting-physics IOU into schema.
